history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Quick reference on public library status meanings: On Shelf/Available = physically present. Checked Out/On Loan = not on shelf. In Transit = moving between branches; not on shelf. On Hold = set aside for patron; not on shelf. Processing = undergoing cataloging/repair; not on shelf. Lost/Missing = not on shelf.

Counting those: Lightning Thief (Checked Out), Titan's Curse (In Transit), Last Olympian (Checked Out), Red Pyramid (Processing), Serpent's Shadow (Checked Out), Mark of Athena (Checked Out) → 6 off-shelf. On Hold entry seems to have been skipped due to the mismatched field name.

mistake_reason: At step 12, FileSurfer produced malformed JSON: single quotes instead of double quotes, a trailing comma in the records array, a nonstandard field name ("availability" instead of "status"), and embedded the JSON within conversational text. This violates the expected structure and causes parsing to drop the "On Hold" entry. As a result, the Assistant counted only 6 off-shelf items instead of 7.
